fact: The Ministry of Public Health's Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2023 (Tome A, 37th edition, July 2024), published annually, compiles health facility monthly activity reports drawn from consultation, delivery and other registers, now entered through DHIS2.
title: Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires, Tome A, 37ème édition, année 2023
